label: День
description: Twelve-mission case drill for день (day) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form день is the subject of the sentence. This masculine inanimate noun hides a fleeting vowel: the е before н appears only in the nominative and accusative singular and drops out in the oblique cases.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The preposition до plus possession requires the genitive, giving дня. The fleeting vowel е drops here, so день contracts to дн- before the ending -я.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. The adjective рад governs the dative, producing дню. Again the fleeting vowel disappears: the stem is дн- and the dative ending -ю attaches to it.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. As the direct object of провели the inanimate noun copies the nominative, returning to the bare form день. Accusative singular keeps the fleeting vowel, since this slot mirrors the nominative.

Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The noun in the instrumental, днём, functions adverbially to mean in the daytime. With the fleeting vowel dropped, the stem дн- takes the soft instrumental ending -ём, note the correct ё.

Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The preposition о (about) requires the prepositional case, giving дне. The fleeting vowel still drops, and the prepositional ending -е attaches to the contracted stem дн-.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject takes дни. The fleeting vowel drops throughout the plural, so the stem is дн- and the nominative plural ending is -и.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The quantifier несколько forces the genitive plural дней. With the fleeting vowel absent, the stem дн- takes the genitive plural ending -ей.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The preposition по governs the dative, here the plural дням. The fleeting vowel stays dropped, and the dative plural ending -ям attaches to the stem дн-.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. As the direct object of помним the inanimate noun copies the nominative plural, giving дни. The accusative equals the nominative for this inanimate noun, both on the contracted stem дн-.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The preposition между selects the instrumental plural днями. With the fleeting vowel dropped, the stem дн- takes the instrumental plural ending -ями.

missions.phrase: В этих днях было много радости.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The preposition в (in) marks the prepositional plural днях. Like every oblique form, it rests on the contracted stem дн-, since the fleeting vowel of день survives only in the nominative and accusative singular.
